john2.1.p1.b1.text: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth …

john2.1.p1.b2.text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.

john2.1.p2.b1.text: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.

john2.1.p2.b2.text: And now I urge you, dear lady … that we love one another.

john2.1.p2.b3.text: … not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning …

john2.1.p2.b4.text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. …

john2.1.p3.b1.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. …

john2.1.p3.b2.text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.

john2.1.p3.b3.text: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.

john2.1.p4.b1.text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. …

john2.1.p4.b2.text: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.

john2.1.p4.b3.text: … Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
